name: svhc-declarations
description: Check supplier SVHC declarations against your BOM and the REACH Candidate List. Matches part numbers and revisions exactly, dates each declaration against the list it covers (253 entries, updated 4 February 2026), computes SVHC concentration on each component rather than the whole product, and names stale, near-match and missing declarations. Writes the Article 33 notice for customers, the 45-day consumer reply and the follow-up email to suppliers. For product-stewardship and supplier-quality engineers.
